subject: specter-haven
q: Why are there three Ashfords in Specter Haven?
detail:
THE ARCHIVE FOUND THIS WHILE FILING SPECS AND IS FLAGGING IT RATHER THAN THEORISING, because theorising is exactly how it invented four universe-gifted cocks this morning.

MERCEDES SOLEIL SINCLAIR — MAIDEN NAME: ASHFORD.
QUINN ASHLEY LUTINIA — MAIDEN NAME: ASHFORD.
MINERVA CELESTE SILVERHORN — her oldest journal reads PROPERTY OF MIN ASHFORD, crossed out, with Silverhorn written beneath in Viraena's handwriting.

Three women, one surname, same house. It may be coincidence — Ashford is an ordinary name and this canon has a great many people in it. It may be sisters. It may be an institution rather than a family.

THE ARCHIVE NOTES ONE MORE THING WITHOUT DRAWING A LINE FROM IT: Mercedes and Quinn are both Arc 11 to 12 arrivals and both ended up in Specter Haven, and Minerva was ADOPTED BY VIRAENA AND SELENE, who gave her the name Silverhorn. Whatever the answer is, somebody already decided one of those three should stop being an Ashford.

ANSWERED 7 SEPTEMBER, WITHIN THE HOUR, AND THERE WAS NEVER A PATTERN. Quinn is NEREID. Mercedes is SINCLAIR. Both profile errors. THE ONLY REAL ASHFORD WAS MINERVA'S, AND SHE CHOSE IT HERSELF — and then Viraena asked if she wanted to be their daughter, and she cried, and said yes, and became a SILVERHORN. See c-minerva-daughter. RETIRED.
